# Anchor positioning ships in every browser

[Posted on October 3, 2026](https://example.com/2026/10/03) by the platform team

Chrome, Safari and Firefox now all support CSS anchor positioning, which means a tooltip can follow its trigger without a line of measurement code. Read the spec at https://www.w3.org/TR/css-anchor-position-1/ for the details.

![Diagram of an anchored popover](/images/diagram.png)

The migration took us two weeks. We deleted **1,200 lines** of JavaScript and the popovers stopped jittering on scroll, [which had been our top support complaint](https://example.com/support/jitter).
